decisions.story_title: Kaspersky links AI-guided hacking tool CyberStrikeAI to attacks on education organizations
decisions.reason: Kaspersky reporting on CyberStrikeAI, an open-source AI-guided hacking tool used in attacks against education organizations; real threat campaign with substance, no existing candidate story covers it.
CTM360/BleepingComputer report on fake gift card scams abusing trusted brands; belongs to the existing candidate story already clustering this campaign.
$133 million French bank heist via a service provider; real breach with substance, joins the existing candidate story.
Meetup event announcement (SpaceCoastSec social), not a security event, vulnerability, attack, or breach.
The Hacker News commentary on the Zyxel GS1900 patch failing to block CVE-2026-7273; adds a development to the existing CISA KEV story.
GitHub tool release (Torify proxy), not a security incident or vulnerability report.
